findings.title: Queue edits silently ignore further clicks while the request is pending

findings.correction: Immediately mark the affected queue action pending and disable queue mutation controls while the request is in flight; restore them and announce the final update or existing failure message when it settles.
findings.verify: Delay each queue move, remove, and autoplay response by three seconds. Verify an immediate pending signal beside the queue, disabled mutation controls throughout the request, no silent actionable controls, and restoration on both success and failure.

cognitive_load.profile: ACT-02 trusted LAN viewer
cognitive_load.rationale: During a queued edit the viewer has no evidence the first click was accepted, while further queue clicks are ignored by the busy guard; this invites uncertainty and repeated work.

findings.user_effect: A screen-reader viewer adjusting playback position receives normalized numeric progress without the elapsed and total time needed to choose a scene accurately.
findings.correction: Set the seek control's aria-valuetext to localized elapsed and total media time whenever its value updates; preserve native range keyboard operation.
findings.verify: With a screen reader, focus the seek control and use arrow keys at multiple positions; the announced value includes meaningful elapsed and total time and updates after both seek and playback progress.

findings.title: Queue updates discard the user's focused episode control
findings.evidence: src/player.js:748 removes every queue row with marathonList.replaceChildren(), then recreates all controls. handleMarathonAction at src/player.js:937-945 invalidates the fingerprint and invokes this renderer after both a successful move/remove and a failed request. No focus capture or restoration accompanies replacement. The focused button is therefore detached even on an unsuccessful edit; periodic state updates also use this renderer.
findings.user_effect: A keyboard viewer moving an episode several positions must locate the episode control again after each operation. A failed queue edit also destroys their navigation position despite retaining the queue data.
findings.correction: Preserve existing keyed queue rows, or capture the focused episode ID/action before replacement and restore its corresponding control afterward. When removal deletes the focused episode, select the next available episode control or the queue heading; preserve focus outside the queue.
findings.verify: Using only the keyboard, move an episode twice and confirm focus follows the same episode/action after each update. Simulate a failed move and confirm the original control retains focus. Remove a focused episode and confirm focus reaches a predictable neighboring control without jumping to the document body.

findings.title: The optional speech feature has no in-product installation handoff

findings.user_effect: A desktop-package user reaches a feature that asks them to activate an unspecified engine, then must leave the product and discover developer setup instructions before completing English synchronization.
findings.correction: Add an unavailable-state help link and host configuration section with exact prerequisites and the supported setup path; clearly identify checkout setup while that is the only supported method.
